evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `main` still dispatches both `drain-alive` and `drain-ambiguous` to `drain_refuse_phase(args)` while `--seed` is parsed independently and passed through unchanged. There is no visible phase/seed consistency check, so `drain-alive --seed ambiguous` can run and record the ambiguity proof under the `drain-alive` phase, producing a named proof that never tested live owned work. This is a concrete input-validation/proof-integrity defect in the existing driver, not a new requirement. Rejecting a conflicting seed before setup, or deriving the seed from the phase, is a small compatible fix.
